title: Path homology of circulant digraphs
summary: We study GLMY path homology of circulant digraphs through step-word complexes and infinite cyclic lifts. We first prove chain retractions for interval connection sets. For a fixed finite positive connection set $S$ containing $1$, the infinite lift yields a split exact sequence and all-degree stability over every field. We then encode the short additive relations of $S$ in a lattice lift and obtain exterior homology in arbitrarily high degrees for collision-free step sets.
